# Fare Class Rules

<!-- page:1 -->
## 4. Fare Class Restrictions

Fare class &F1 requires 14 days advance purchase & is non-refundable.

Fare class &F1 must be issued at least 14 days before departure.

- Advance purchase: 14 days minimum.
- Stopover not permitted.

| Fare Class | 14-Day Advance | Non-Refundable |
| --- | --- | --- |
| One-way fare class | yes | yes |
| Round-trip fare class | yes | no |
